title: E-SLF-0155: a frozen-snapshot planner and a local gradient tracker pursue a drifting peak: in a static world the...
purpose: Experiment E-SLF-0155 in the selves arena: a frozen-snapshot planner and a local gradient tracker pursue a drifting peak: in a static world the plan is optimal (the control), and past a measured drift-rate crossover the locally-sensed tracker wins because its error stays bounded while the stale plan error grows, the plan-versus-signal trade made exact and deterministic.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
